C163.name: Mpanda Municipal Council
C163.documented: seasonal floods on the Katavi wetlands, drought in the dry months, wildfire, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mpanda Municipal: town streams and valley settlements
area.sw: Manispaa ya Mpanda: vijito vya mjini na makazi ya mabondeni

risk.en: This area is a fast-growing town where seasonal streams flood low streets and unplanned plots during heavy Msimu storms, and lightning is frequent.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji unaokua kwa kasi ambapo vijito vya msimu hufurika mitaa ya chini na viwanja holela wakati wa dhoruba kali za Msimu, na radi hupiga mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and stream reserves clear, build above known flood marks and fit lightning arresters on schools and markets. What raises the risk: taking up plots inside the stream reserves, filling drains with waste and sheltering under trees or in open ground when thunder starts. Know the higher street or school ground away from the stream that you will move to, and go when the stream rises towards the road; get into a solid roofed building as soon as thunder is heard. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na hifadhi za vijito wazi, kujenga juu ya alama za mafuriko zinazojulikana na kuweka vizuia radi shuleni na masokoni. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchukua viwanja ndani ya hifadhi za vijito, kujaza mitaro kwa taka na kujikinga chini ya miti au uwanjani ngurumo zinapoanza. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule mbali na kijito utakaohamia, na ondoka kijito kinapoanza kupanda kuelekea barabarani; ingia kwenye jengo imara lenye paa mara ngurumo zinaposikika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C166.name: Mlele District Council
C166.documented: drought, wildfire, wet-season floods on the Rukwa plains, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mlele: Katavi plains and reserve edges
area.sw: Mlele: tambarare za Katavi na pembezoni mwa hifadhi

risk.en: This area borders Katavi National Park and forest reserves: wildlife raids crops, dry-season fires spread through miombo, and rivers flood the plains in heavy rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na Hifadhi ya Taifa Katavi na hifadhi za misitu: wanyamapori huvamia mazao, moto wa kiangazi husambaa kwenye miombo, na mito hufurika tambarare wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep fire breaks around homes and fields, use community deterrents against wildlife and keep homes off the flood plain. What raises the risk: opening fields and settling right against the reserve boundary, burning grass on windy days and building on the river flood plain. Know the cleared open ground away from the miombo that your village will move to if fire comes, and the raised ground away from the river for floods; leave as soon as smoke is seen or the river starts to rise. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuweka njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka nyumba na mashamba, kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama na kujenga nje ya tambarare za mafuriko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba na kukaa moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi, kuchoma nyasi siku za upepo na kujenga kwenye tambarare za mafuriko za mto. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa mbali na miombo ambao kijiji chenu kitahamia moto ukija, na eneo lililoinuka mbali na mto kwa mafuriko; ondokeni mara moshi unapoonekana au mto unapoanza kujaa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C165.name: Mpanda District Council
C165.documented: drought, wildfire, floods beside Lake Rukwa, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mpanda DC: Lake Tanganyika shore (Karema) and hills
area.sw: Mpanda DC: ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika (Karema) na milima

risk.en: This area includes the Lake Tanganyika shore around Karema, where sudden lake storms capsize boats, and steep hills where rain washes out remote roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika kuzunguka Karema, ambapo dhoruba za ghafla ziwani hupindua vyombo, na milima mikali ambapo mvua husomba barabara za mbali.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore when storms build and keep homes back from the shoreline and gullies. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded or unlit boats, fishing on when clouds build over the lake and building on the beach or at gully mouths. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds and the firm ground above the gullies that your household will move to in heavy rain; move before the road is cut, since help here takes hours. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni dhoruba inapojitokeza na kujenga mbali na ufukwe na makorongo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa, kuendelea kuvua mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa na kujenga ufukweni au midomoni mwa makorongo. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka na eneo imara juu ya makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia wakati wa mvua kubwa; ondokeni kabla barabara haijakatika, kwani msaada hapa huchukua saa nyingi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C167.name: Mpimbwe District Council
C167.documented: drought, wildfire, Lake Rukwa floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Mpimbwe: Lake Rukwa flood plain and Usevya
area.sw: Mpimbwe: tambarare ya mafuriko ya Ziwa Rukwa na Usevya

risk.en: This area lies on the Lake Rukwa flood plain: in wet years the lake and rivers spread over rice fields and villages, while drought brings herder–farmer conflict.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Ziwa Rukwa: katika miaka ya mvua nyingi ziwa na mito hutanuka na kufunika mashamba ya mpunga na vijiji, na ukame huleta migogoro ya wakulima na wafugaji.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to keep homes and stores on higher ground, use the flood plain seasonally and follow agreed grazing routes. What raises the risk: building permanent houses and stores on the flood plain, blocking the natural outflow with bunds and roads, and taking herds off the agreed routes into planted fields. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use, and move people, stores and animals there when the lake and rivers start to spread, not when the water reaches the houses. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kujenga makazi na maghala sehemu za miinuko, kutumia tambarare kwa msimu na kufuata njia za malisho zilizokubaliwa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba na maghala ya kudumu kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko, kuziba njia ya asili ya maji kwa matuta na barabara, na kutoa mifugo nje ya njia zilizokubaliwa kuingia mashambani. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia, na hamisheni watu, akiba na mifugo huko ziwa na mito vinapoanza kutanuka, si maji yanapofika nyumbani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C164.name: Nsimbo District Council
C164.documented: drought, wildfire, seasonal wetland floods, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Nsimbo: miombo farms and mining areas
area.sw: Nsimbo: mashamba ya miombo na maeneo ya uchimbaji

risk.en: This area combines miombo farmland, tobacco and small-scale mining: fires spread in the dry season, and pits collapse and flood during the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya mashamba ya miombo, tumbaku na uchimbaji mdogo: moto husambaa wakati wa kiangazi, na mashimo hubomoka na kujaa maji wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and working here, it helps to burn early and under control, fence or backfill pits and divert run-off away from pit mouths. What raises the risk: burning late in the dry season when the wind is up, digging pits without timbering and working them while rain is falling. Know the open cleared ground your household will move to if fire comes, and keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts; do not go back in to recover tools until the ground has drained. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya kazi hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mapema kwa udhibiti, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo na kuelekeza maji mbali na midomo ya mashimo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mwishoni mwa kiangazi upepo ukiwa mkali, kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili na kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto ukija, na mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza; usirudi ndani kuchukua vifaa hadi ardhi ikauke. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
